title: Starting Retention Share by Concession History: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Revenue management rule.** The retention share on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement starts from the agreement's concession history, counted as the retention concessions noticed on the agreement in the **36 months** up to the handling date:

| Retention concessions noticed in the 36 months | Starting retention share |
|---|---|
| none | 60 percent |
| one | 55 percent |
| two or more | the class's retention share |

The class's retention share is 50 percent in every class: Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Bluegate Interior Standard, Bluegate Climate Controlled, Bluegate Climate Plus, Bluegate Premier Climate Suite and Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault.

The concessions are read from the agreement's rent change history: notices with the reason retention concession whose notice date falls within the 36 months up to the handling date.

## Hypothetical cases (handling date 1 March 2027)

- No concession since the agreement began: 60 percent.
- One concession noticed on 12 June 2024: 55 percent.
- Concessions noticed on 12 June 2024 and 3 May 2025: 50 percent.
- One concession noticed on 1 January 2024, outside the 36 months: 60 percent.
